page_title: BET 1-1 OSA | Betis v Osasuna 11/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Antony (Betis) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Ortiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+4' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+3' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+3' Pablo Garcia (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+2' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Bryan Zaragoza and he is replaced by Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna).
89' Substitution. Jesus Areso (Osasuna) makes way for Kike Barja.
88' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
87' The resulting corner from Isco (Betis) is cleared by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Betis.
86' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.

83' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Adrian shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
83' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Antony (Betis) offside.
80' It is time for a substitution. Pablo Garcia (Betis) is on for Abde Ezzalzouli.
79' Substitution. Johnny Cardoso (Betis) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Sergi Altimira walks off.
79' Vicente Moreno prepares a substitution. Ante Budimir is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
79' The referee signals a substitution. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is brought on as a substitute for Pablo Ibanez.
78' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sergi Altimira (Betis) was quite harsh and Miguel Ortiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' 1 - 1 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Aimar Oroz and Ante Budimir (Osasuna) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 1:1.
72' Rough tackle by Marc Bartra (Betis). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
70' The total number of attempts is 9:10.
67' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Betis, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
67' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Miguel Ortiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Betis have a free kick.
64' 1 - 0 Isco showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Cucho Hernandez (Betis) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 1:0.

62' What a great effort! Pablo Fornals (Betis) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
61' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
60' Antony (Betis) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Sergio Herrera and he's equal to it.
57' Here is a change. Ruben Garcia is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
57' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. William Carvalho will be replaced by Pablo Fornals (Betis).
56' A substitution has been made. Jesus Rodriguez goes off and Antony (Betis) comes on.
56' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
55' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
54' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Sergio Herrera easily deals with the threat.
51' Close! Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
49' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) comes off for Isco.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Miguel Ortiz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Ortiz had an easy-decision to make.
45' Osasuna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

45' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the left side of the goal, but great anticipation by Adrian allowed him to make a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. Osasuna win a corner kick.
45' The ball goes out of play. Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
42' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar.
41' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) launches a cross from the corner, but Adrian is alert to thwart the effort.
40' The game is interrupted. Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
38' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) commits a rough foul. Miguel Ortiz stops the game and makes a call.
37' A shot from the edge of the box by Cucho Hernandez (Betis) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
36' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

36' Romain Perraud (Betis) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Betis are going to take it.
36' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.

35' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Good work from Betis as they win a corner.

34' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Miguel Ortiz with no other option than to blow for a foul.
31' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Sergio Herrera was alert and made a comfortable save.
30' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul.
28' A short pass finds Ruben Garcia (Osasuna). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
28' Osasuna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
26' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) makes a strong challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul.

24' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
23' Romain Perraud (Betis) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
22' William Carvalho (Betis) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul.
19' Miguel Ortiz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lucas Torro (Osasuna).
14' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
11' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Betis.
9' Miguel Ortiz shows a yellow card to Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
9' The resulting corner from Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is cleared.
7' A thunderous effort from long range by Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) goes well wide of the left post.
4' Romain Perraud (Betis) was too forceful with his tackle and Miguel Ortiz interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
4' Betis are seeing far more of the ball now.
1' The first half has started.
Osasuna will kick-off.
Miguel Ortiz is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
